forbidden.name: pure-packages-have-no-io
forbidden.comment: HR-7 / pack 02 section 3: contracts, core, policy, state, context/assembler, review scorer+panel and merge rules are PURE. No node:fs/net/child_process, no pg, no network, no clock, no randomness except injected.

forbidden.name: pure-packages-have-no-io-subpaths
forbidden.comment: HR-7: the same ban, including subpath imports such as node:fs/promises.

forbidden.name: pure-packages-have-no-db-client
forbidden.comment: HR-7: a pure package may not depend on a database driver or the event log.

forbidden.name: pure-packages-no-external-dependencies
forbidden.comment: HR-7: a pure package may not import a third-party module that performs I/O (network clients, fs wrappers, SDK clients).

forbidden.name: packages-never-import-apps
forbidden.comment: pack 02 section 3: packages never import apps/*.

forbidden.name: apps-never-import-apps
forbidden.comment: pack 02 section 3: apps/* wire packages together; they do not import each other.

forbidden.name: contracts-imports-nothing-internal
forbidden.comment: pack 02 section 3: contracts imports nothing internal.

forbidden.name: core-only-depends-on-contracts
forbidden.comment: pack 02 section 3: core -> contracts. core depends on no other internal package.

forbidden.name: orchestrator-may-not-import-apps
forbidden.comment: pack 02 section 3: orchestrator may import everything except apps.
